theorem lg_target {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : Set (α → β)) (s : Set α) [Finite ↑f] [Finite ↑s] : Finite ↑(f.seq s) := by
  let f_set := ↑f
  let s_set := ↑s
  let f_seq_s := ⋃ g ∈ f_set, s_set → g
  have fin_f_seq_s : Finite ↑f_seq_s :=
    Finite.union f_finite (λ g hg,
      let g_set := ↑g,
      have fin_func_set : Finite ↑(s_set → g_set) :=
        Finite.Set.finite_image s_set (fun x => x) s_finite,
      exact fin_func_set)
  exact fin_f_seq_s
